messages:
Aisha Rana: Support escalated an activation failure for Aureum Labs — their pilot can't complete onboarding, renewal in ~28 days. Flagging for CS takeover.
Dev Support Bot: Ticket SL-9092 created by support@redwood. Severity: high. https://support.internal/SL-9092
Carlos Mendes: Quick context plz? customer on dedicated or hosted?
Aisha Rana: Dedicated. Error during activation: orchestration service returns 403 on final step. Support rotated credentials and retried 10 times.
Evelyn Yu: Any error logs?
Aisha Rana: Paste: ```2026-03-19T15:03:12Z ERROR orchestration: activation denied tenant=aur-labs uid=svc-orch status=403 reason=policy_mismatch
2026-03-19T15:04:01Z INFO retrying activation step=final attempts=4```
Carlos Mendes: Policy_mismatch suggests their tenant-level policy (ingest->activate) is missing an allow rule. Could be our tenant bootstrap maps not applied.
Tess Morgan: I'm on renewals; this is high risk. If they can't run pilot for next week, renewal convo will be hard. We need comms asap.
Aisha Rana: Proposed immediate steps: 1) schedule emergency triage call within 4 hours; 2) give customer an isolated fallback (hosted route with encrypted transit) while we fix; 3) set internal SLA 24h for root cause.
Carlos Mendes: I can investigate tenant bootstrap and policy store, need tenant id and sample request id.
Aisha Rana: Tenant: aur-772. Sample req id from logs: req-0a9c3f.
Dev Support Bot: Note: customer contact Maria Alvarez (maria@aureum.ai) - prefers PST afternoons.
Tess Morgan: Draft comms to customer (short): "Hi Maria 1 we7ve opened a prioritized investigation. We propose a joint call today at 16:00 PST to validate configuration. If needed, we will enable a temporary isolated fallback so your pilot continues. Will follow with an update in 24 hours."
Evelyn Yu: @Carlos can you check whether dedicated tenant bootstrap succeeded? I recall a recent deploy touched the tenant-store migration.
Carlos Mendes: Checking now. Quick note: last deploy 2026-03-18 02:14 UTC touched migrations. If migration failed for this tenant, their policy bindings may be missing.
Carlos Mendes: Confirmed: tenant aur-772 missing binding: allow:activation for role:svc-orch. Patch available.
Aisha Rana: Great find. What's ETA for applying patch?
Carlos Mendes: Can push a one-off binding change in 20 minutes after approvals. Need Ops SRE to approve for dedicated pools.
Tess Morgan: I'll escalate to Ops and loop in account owner for exec transparency.
Dev Support Bot: Created infra request: INF-3221 to apply temp binding with rollback plan. Link: https://infra.internal/INF-3221
Aisha Rana: Plan A: apply binding now, confirm activation on call. Plan B: if binding cannot apply quickly, offer hosted fallback with strict contract and customer-approved isolation.
Evelyn Yu: Also capture feedback: customer said onboarding docs didn't mention the specific role-binding step clearly. We should update docs after this.
Carlos Mendes: Pushing binding change now (audit note included).
Dev Support Bot: INF-3221 status: in-progress. Change window set now.
Aisha Rana: Maria confirmed 16:00 PST call is good. I'll send invite and include SE and SRE.
Tess Morgan: I logged renewal risk in CRM with severity "high" and assigned to AM. If this drags beyond 48h, I will prepare a discount/extension proposal.
Carlos Mendes: Binding applied. Please retry activation.
Dev Support Bot: Support note: retry command issued by support@redwood at 2026-03-19T15:28:10Z, operation retry-req-0a9c3f.
Aisha Rana: Update: Activation succeeded on first retry after binding. Customer acknowledged on call, relieved but concerned about timeline impact.
Evelyn Yu: Great. Next steps: 1) schedule postmortem to identify migration test gaps; 2) publish concise correction to onboarding docs highlighting role binding; 3) send customer email summarizing fix + mitigation.
Tess Morgan: Also share an executive summary for AM to use in renewal talk. I'll draft and share.
Carlos Mendes: I'll add the audit entry and monitor dedicated pools for similar missing bindings.
Aisha Rana: Thanks team. I'll post call minutes, the customer's sentiment (nervous but satisfied with fix) and set follow-up for 24h. :white_check_mark:
Dev Support Bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 24h for CS update.
